issues.where: f1199 to f1200 (39.97 to 40.00 s), distant ridge and field silhouettes on either side of the stem
issues.what: The main plant holds its framing and the weather changes in one frame, but the ridge contour and upright field silhouettes do not register across the cut.
issues.fix: Carry the same terrain and field geometry through the cut and swap only the weather, lighting, and surface state at f1200.

issues.where: f1331 to f1342 (44.37 to 44.73 s), backlit bract rims on the center-right of the bud and the lower-left leaf edge
issues.what: The fine rim detail breaks into jagged, bright specks whose brightness and continuity change between nearby frames, even on bracts that barely move.
issues.fix: Keep the hairs fixed to the deforming surfaces and increase sampling and subpixel filtering on the rim-lit edges until individual hairs remain coherent across frames.
